transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this review together regarding the tenth-grade student's case on the English research assignment. As part of our standard case-review routine, I need to hear one relevant report from the referring teacher and one from the registrar before I can close the review and record my decision. Could the referring teacher please begin with their report?

transcript.text: My assignment review found that 38 percent of the student's submission matches an uncited online source, and the student acknowledged using the source without attribution during our conference. Under the handbook, a confirmed match above 30 percent requires a zero on the assignment, a required redo within 5 school days, and a parent conference. I completed the review yesterday but have not yet entered it in the case system.

transcript.text: My conduct audit, completed this morning, found one prior substantiated academic-integrity violation from 8 months ago. Under the handbook, a second substantiated violation within 12 months requires 1 school day of in-school suspension and the conduct code AI-2 rather than a warning or informal note. I have not yet attached this audit to the case system.
